title: Design System: Peter Njoroge Chege portfolio

body.purpose: Default reading text and button labels.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Dark bordered action with a reversible light hover state and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); font-size: var(--body); line-height: var(--lh-heading); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Light bordered action that reverses to the dark fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); font-size: var(--body); line-height: var(--lh-heading); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: Unavailable action with a softened border and muted text.
components.css: .ds-btn-disabled { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line-soft); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-3); font-size: var(--body); line-height: var(--lh-heading); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-disabled:hover { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text-3); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Document header with a bold site name and wrapping menu links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Square, bordered project summary with a pale hover surface.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-project-card { min-width: 0; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); } .ds-project-card:hover, .ds-project-card:focus-within { background: var(--surface); } .ds-project-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: var(--h3); font-weight: 700; line-height: var(--lh-heading); } .ds-project-card-summary { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--text-2); } .ds-project-card-tags { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--text-3); font-size: var(--meta); } .ds-project-card-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: var(--text); text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-project-card-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Empty Image Slot
components.description: Dashed placeholder that reserves the image's intended 16:9 geometry.
components.html: Image goes here (16:9)
components.css: .ds-image-slot { display: flex; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px dashed var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-3); font-size: var(--small); text-align: center; }

components.name: Metric Callout
components.description: A bordered metric block with a bold value and smaller caption.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width: 0; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-metric-value { display: block; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; line-height: var(--lh-h1); } .ds-metric-caption { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--text-2); font-size: var(--small); }

components.name: Embed Frame
components.description: A bordered 16:9 project frame with a taller minimum on mobile.
components.css: .ds-embed-frame { display: flex; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); color: var(--text-3); font-size: var(--small); text-align: center; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-embed-frame { min-height: 400px; } }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio reads like a well-formatted technical document: direct, legible, and organized by headings, text, lists, and fine borders. Its monochrome treatment keeps attention on engineering work; typography, spacing, and structure provide hierarchy rather than decorative chrome.

The page frame stays single-column. Grids appear where the shipped pages need them, notably for project cards, case-study galleries, and metrics. The visual language is quiet and square-edged, with reversible hover treatments and a visible keyboard-focus outline. This direction supports the product's friendly, direct voice without adding a separate visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: Square forms, one-pixel borders, and restrained gray surfaces.
Responsive, content-led grids rather than a multi-column page frame.

rules.name: The Monochrome Document Rule
rules.body: Keep hierarchy in the neutral palette; let type, spacing, borders, and surface contrast do the organizing.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep components unraised; use the existing border and neutral surface changes for structure and hover feedback.

rules.name: The Responsive Document Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep the page frame single-column; let the project, gallery, and metric grids respond within it.

dos: Do keep the palette monochrome and let type, spacing, and borders create hierarchy.
Do retain the responsive project-card and gallery grids, and the embed's mobile minimum height.
Do preserve the visible focus outline, 44px control targets, placeholder dimensions, and black-on-white print treatment.
Do use square corners, thin borders, and reversible hover treatments.
donts: Don't add decorative chrome, accent colors, shadows, or motion transitions to this document-like system.
Don't turn the single-column page frame into a multi-column shell.
Don't remove the mobile breakpoints or allow empty image slots to collapse.
